result.query: SELECT json_build_object('active_attachments',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_attachments WHERE state<>'released'),'active_lb_refs',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_lb_subnet_refs WHERE released_at IS NULL),'subnets',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id',subnet_id,'state',state)) FROM network_subnets WHERE state<>'deleted'));
